decisions.reason: As a multi-model office system that extends the core range and supports the firm's stated move toward flexible workplace interiors, it carries enough sunk development and strategic commitment for management to continue backing it.
The chair family remains close to the established offer and the earlier dedicated presentation makes withdrawal harder to justify, so management is likely to persist unless results are clearly poor.

These floor cushions are more niche than the firm's main lines, but the firm invested in a full product line and can still frame weaker performance as temporary within its broader design-led interiors concept.
Because this sofa had the weakest visible commitment from the start, management has less need to defend it and is more likely by now to reallocate resources to stronger core and development projects.
The high standing table fits the firm's contemporary office and lounge direction and its dedicated launch visibility reinforces escalation of commitment toward continued support.

Even though rugs are more distant from the traditional offer, the collection was publicly framed as a flagship direction, which strongly encourages management to keep it on the market and justify the earlier commitment.
